beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Shanghai compresses schedule, factory-city, social image, cloud runway, buyer order, product identity and distributed memory into synchronized platform time. This chapter follows backstage coordination: The same field that helps a show run—a name, measurement, image, availability or location—can also make labor newly trackable and extractable.
beats.onScreen: Then: The official 2026 schedule lists MODE, Ontimeshow and multiple showrooms alongside runway presentations, making trade infrastructure part of the week’s public interface.

beats.voice: The official 2026 schedule lists MODE, Ontimeshow and multiple showrooms alongside runway presentations, making trade infrastructure part of the week’s public interface. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: Ontimeshow’s official archive describes showroom encounters among brands, buyers and industry participants; its reproduced journalism remains separately attributed.

beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
